statBlock.name: Ice Devil
statBlock.description: A towering insectile commander of the infernal armies, with powerful mandibles and a barbed tail.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness leaves the devil's darkvision unchanged.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claws, and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing and 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing and 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning and 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Wall of Ice (Recharge 6). Magically form an opaque ice barrier on a solid surface the devil can see within 60 ft. The ice is 1 ft. thick. The devil chooses a wall up to 30 ft. long and 10 ft. high or a hemispherical dome up to 20 ft. across.
When it forms, each creature occupying its space is pushed out by the shortest route. The creature can choose which side it ends up on unless it is Incapacitated. It then rolls a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 35 (10d6) cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
The barrier lasts 1 minute or ends early if the devil becomes Incapacitated or dies. Each 10-ft. section has AC 5 and 30 HP, is vulnerable to fire, and is immune to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage.
A destroyed section leaves frigid air in its space. A creature that finishes passing through the air on a turn, including by forced movement, makes a DC 17 Constitution save. It takes 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The air clears when the rest of the barrier vanishes.
sections.Infernal return: A devil that dies outside the Nine Hells vanishes in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor. It immediately reforms at full strength on its home layer. Death in the Nine Hells destroys it permanently.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67, 69 and 75. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Erinyes
statBlock.description: A winged enforcer of the Nine Hells who can pass for a celestial before drawing a weapon.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Hellish Weapons. The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical. On a hit they deal 13 (3d8) extra poison damage, already included in the attacks below.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands. Either grip adds 13 (3d8) poison damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing and 13 (3d8) poison damage. The target rolls a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it becomes Poisoned until Lesser Restoration or similar magic removes the poison.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 4 to AC against one melee attack that would hit. The erinyes must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Infernal return: A devil that dies outside the Nine Hells vanishes in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor. It immediately reforms at full strength on its home layer. Death in the Nine Hells destroys it permanently.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67, 70 and 73. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Erinyes (Rope of Entanglement)
statBlock.description: A winged enforcer equipped with an enchanted rope that ties down a target from a distance.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Hellish Weapons. The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical. On a hit they deal 13 (3d8) extra poison damage, already included in the attacks below.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, or use the Rope of Entanglement and make one attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands. Either grip adds 13 (3d8) poison damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing and 13 (3d8) poison damage. The target rolls a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it becomes Poisoned until Lesser Restoration or similar magic removes the poison.
Rope of Entanglement. Hold one end of the rope and speak its command word as an action, or spend two attacks from Multiattack to use it. Choose one visible creature within 20 ft. It must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Restrained.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 4 to AC against one melee attack that would hit. The erinyes must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Infernal return: A devil that dies outside the Nine Hells vanishes in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor. It immediately reforms at full strength on its home layer. Death in the Nine Hells destroys it permanently.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67, 70 and 73, including the Rope of Entanglement sidebar. Dungeon Master's Guide (2014), pp. 197–198, supplies the item rules. Resistance wording follows the official errata.
sections.Special equipment:
The Rope of Entanglement is 30 ft. long, weighs 3 lb., has AC 20 and 20 HP. It recovers 1 HP every 5 minutes while above 0 HP and is destroyed at 0 HP.
The erinyes can release the creature by speaking a second command word as a bonus action. A Restrained target can spend an action and pass a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check of its choice to escape.

statBlock.name: Horned Devil
statBlock.description: A heavily scaled soldier of the Nine Hells who strikes from the air with an iron fork and a lashing tail.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness leaves the devil's darkvision unchanged.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fork attacks and one Tail attack. Hurl Flame can replace any of the three attacks.
Fork. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. A creature other than an undead or construct must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or suffer an infernal wound. It loses 10 (3d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. Each Tail hit against that wounded target increases the loss by 10 (3d6). Any creature can spend an action to stanch the wound with a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Magical healing also closes it.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) fire damage. A flammable object catches fire if nobody is wearing or carrying it.
sections.Infernal return: A devil that dies outside the Nine Hells vanishes in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor. It immediately reforms at full strength on its home layer. Death in the Nine Hells destroys it permanently.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67, 69 and 74. Hit dice and resistance wording follow the official errata.
